retrieval_history: Initial direct W3C crawl stopped after session review cancellation. An authorized same-source recovery met HTTP 429 and was stopped. With parent authorization, one public official pinned GitHub archive supplied the remaining 714 HTML pages, while W3C cooldown was respected. All 260 overlapping main texts were equal. No authentication or access restriction was bypassed.
scope_limits: All 974 HTML pages are accounted for. Normative prose was read through full XSD annotation review, duplicate-text reconciliation, 203 unmatched reference-intro paragraphs, 370 unique attribute descriptions, 414 datatype descriptions and 9 example narrative paragraphs. Illustrative XML/music images are not treated as universal rules.
No external normative dependency closure: XML/XSD/XLink/XML Base/XML ID, ZIP/JAR/DEFLATE, SMuFL, IPA, MIME/IANA specifications not fully audited here.

No dedicated design chapter is linked in the dated site navigation; design discussion in tutorials/code-generation and schema overview was reviewed. External design papers were not added without a 4.0 pin.
Code samples and musical images are illustrative. No new universal requirements are inferred from their contents.
No musical-completeness, performance-quality or renderer-equivalence guarantee follows from schema validity.
repository_packaging: The 14,569-entry section_coverage block hash index is not vendored. All 974 page records, all 642 annotation records, their dispositions, all aggregate counts, and the source ledger checksum are retained. The omitted per-block evidence requires the original research archive; it cannot be reconstructed from the summary.

omitted_section_coverage.reason: Fine-grained HTML block inventory is archival evidence, not a separate requirements registry. Page and annotation coverage remain here.
